# Socket.dev -- Reference
<!-- Generated By: Claude Code (Claude Opus 4.6) -->

## Overview

Supply chain security platform that analyzes package behavior rather than
relying solely on CVE databases [37]. Founded 2021 by Feross Aboukhadijeh
(Stanford) [38]. Total funding: $65M including $40M Series B (October 2023)
[38][40].

## Detection Approach

Unlike traditional SCA tools that check for known CVEs, Socket's internal
static analysis engine checks third-party code for [38]:
- Network access capabilities
- Filesystem access
- Shell execution
- Environment variable access
- Code obfuscation
- Install scripts
- Telemetry

This is combined with package metadata and maintainer behavior signals (ownership
changes, suspicious publishing patterns) [38]. Tracks 70+ "red flag" signals [37].

## Ecosystem Coverage

10+ ecosystems: npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, RubyGems, Cargo, NuGet, and more [38].
JavaScript and Python have the deepest coverage.

## CLI

- Install: `npm install -g @socketsecurity/cli` [38]
- Wraps npm, yarn, pnpm, pip transparently [38]
- "Socket Firewall" blocks malicious dependencies at install time [38]
- Scans packages in real-time during installation [38]

## Pricing

| Tier | Features |
|------|----------|
| Free/Individual | Unlimited devs and repos, 70+ risk types, malware blocking, AI analysis [41] |
| Team | Reachability analysis (claims 60% CVE false positive reduction), priority scoring, Slack alerts [41] |
| Enterprise | Unlimited scans/API, SBOM import/export, compliance (Vanta), SCIM, audit logs, GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps [41] |

Per-developer pricing. Dollar amounts not publicly listed [41].

## Scale and Adoption

- End 2024: 7,500+ organizations, 300,000+ GitHub repos [39]
- December 2025: 10,000+ organizations [39]
- Coana acquisition (May 2024): reachability analysis, claiming 80% false
  positive reduction [39]

## Key Differentiator

Socket detects threats that CVE-based scanners structurally cannot find:
malware, typosquatting, dependency confusion, compromised maintainer accounts,
and suspicious package behavior [37][38]. This is the primary gap in tools like
npm audit, pip-audit, and Dependabot.

## Gaps and Limitations

- Dollar pricing not publicly available [41]
- "80% false positive reduction" and "60% CVE false positive reduction"
  are vendor claims, not independently verified [39][41]
- Adoption statistics are from Socket's own marketing materials [39]
